source_bindings_scope: Runtime-bound listed source/data files; not a complete transitive environment manifest
screening_scope: r->0 limit of the accepted low-q ten-valence C/lambda Yukawa proxy; one isotropic Huke Eq10 factor using finite-width band-RMS velocity; not a full large-q/contact dielectric response, core correction or U18
dynamic_scope: frozen-incident-speed approximation: both microscopic terms use the same nominal incident E_lab=2*E_cm, at every depth including the adsorbed sheet; not component-resolved slowing-down dynamics; molecular, spread and neutral components receive the nominal-setting shift through the unchanged consumer
rate_mapping: Ue_shift_keV(E_cm,z)=[U10_Pd(2*E_cm)-U10_PdD(2*E_cm)]/1000; Pd transported profiles/stopping/adsorbate with common PdD phenomenological calibration; no absolute microscopic screening added to a fit
uncertainty: Pd k12/k24 velocity sensitivity is available in the saved controls but only the primary Pd/PdD models enter this candidate; no PdD velocity-grid control or global convergence claim; static proxies retain prior conditional numerical allowance, not a global physical error bound
fitted_values_scope: All original compare fields retained. matched_{Pd,PdD,Ti,TiD}_Ue_effective_{0,1,2}_keV are the actual corresponding paper Eq7 refits supplied by compare, not the quoted paper Ue or microscopic screening. Ue_effective_{0,1,2}_keV are the candidate diagnostic Eq7 fits. Powers 0/1/2 are additional inverse-current corrections to the native cause reading; cause_fit_current_power retains that reading. Existing cause parameters are not refitted.
